mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO health_record (user_id, elderly_name, age, systolic_pressure, diastolic_pressure, heart_rate, blood_sugar, temperature, source, voice_text, risk_level, ai_advice, is_alert, record_time, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{elderlyName}, #{age}, #{systolicPressure}, #{diastolicPressure}, #{heartRate}, #{bloodSugar}, #{temperature}, #{source}, #{voiceText}, IFNULL(#{riskLevel}, 'low'), #{aiAdvice}, #{isAlert},
#{recordTime} NOW() , NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM health_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY record_time DESC
SELECT FROM health_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY record_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM health_record WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM health_record WHERE is_alert = 1 AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
